newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer says Q3 gold earnings rise.
newsitem.headline: Placer says Q3 gold earnings rise.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc said on Wednesday its gold earnings improved in the third quarter over the first half due to higher production and reduced cash operating costs.
Its third-quarter gold operating earnings were US$74 million, down from US$77 million in the same period of 1995, but up from US$41 million and US$47 million in the first and second quarters of 1996.
Placer's total net earnings fell to US$0.07 a share in the third quarter from US$0.10 a year earlier.

Placer said its gold production in the third quarter was 503,000 ounces, bringing its total for the first nine months to 1,438,000 ounces, up six percent from 1995. Higher output was achieved at its Granny Smith, Dome, Cortez and Golden Sunlight mines.
Placer said its average cash production costs fell to US$210 an ounce from US$246 in the first half. The cash cost for the first nine months was US$233 an ounce, up from US$215 an ounce in 1995.
